GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.23 (25 Aug 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1759/2)
APO 500
25 August 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Relaxation of Restrictions Pertaining to Acceptance of Messages Between Japan and Western Hemisphere Points.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 311.23(10 Aug 47)CCS, (SCAPIN 1759), dated 10 August 1947, subject: Expansion of Radiotelegraph Service via the United States.
2. Private messages from any organization or person in Japan authorized to possess and use United States Military Payment Certificates, or Foreign Trade Payment Certificates, or who is specifically named in a prepaid reply (RP) voucher, to any organization or person at the points listed in Inclosure 1 of the reference memorandum, are authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
